messages:
sophie-support: customers reporting ~20% 5xx rate from eu3 over the last 10m, mostly 502/504 and timeouts. multiple apps and tenants. high severity escalations from two enterprise customers.

zach-support: getting live repro from Customer A. sequence: send request -> 200 for a bit -> then 504s and long connect times. they say it started ~11:12 UTC.

matt-eng: I see a matching spike on the hosted-api gateway in eu3 at 2026-03-17T11:12:xxZ. latency p50 -> p95 jumped, retries up.

olivia-oncall: @matt-eng can you paste the gateway logs? also any auth failures? customers mention token refresh errors intermittently.

matt-eng: logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T11:12:08Z gateway eu3: upstream: connection reset by peer while reading response header
2026-03-17T11:12:09Z gateway eu3: 502 POST /v1/generate token=ok route=hosted-model-7 region=eu3
2026-03-17T11:12:11Z gateway eu3: 504 timeout waiting for response from backend
```

raj-netops: running quick path checks between AZs and to provider. traceroute from eu3-azb -> eu3-edge shows repeated retransmits in hop 6-8, gap in RTT and some RTOs.

raj-netops: traceroute snippet:
```
1 10.0.4.1 0.32 ms
2 100.65.12.1 0.88 ms
3 198.51.100.23 12.4 ms
4 203.0.113.7 45.6 ms  !H  (packet loss begins)
5 203.0.113.9 48.0 ms  50% loss
6 198.51.100.45 120 ms  70% loss
```

sophie-support: Customer A also collected a tcpdump showing TCP retransmits and duplicated ACKs around the same time. They sent it to support inbox.

zach-support: customers seeing some 401s mixed in too, likely post-retry-timeouts when token validation requests fail. we have 4 customer escalations on phone right now.

olivia-oncall: triage plan: 1) Confirm if problem is intra-region cross-AZ interconnect or upstream provider. 2) If provider, get peering team on call + open provider ticket. 3) Apply temporary routing fallback to eu3-secondary-pop for gateways if safe. 4) Notify customers and set status page.

matt-eng: quick check in infra: backend nodes healthy, no CPU/GPU pressure. KV cache hit rate normal. So likely network.

eng-sre-bot: Deploy job failed to push a small gateway hotfix at 11:15 due to intermittent API 502s; automated rollback happened.

raj-netops: I see BGP AS-path change on one upstream transit peer at 11:10 UTC and a flapping session between 11:10-11:20. Correlates with loss window. opening ticket with transit provider (TP-45678).

olivia-oncall: @raj-netops please include sample pcap + traceroute + best-effort timeline in the ticket. set priority P1.

raj-netops: done. ticket TP-45678 created. contacting provider NOC now.

sophie-support: drafting customer update for status page. key points: impacting requests in eu3, engineering investigating, mitigation being evaluated. any suggested text?

matt-eng: suggested: "We are investigating networking instability in the eu3 region impacting inference requests resulting in 502/504 responses and increased latencies. Mitigation: routing to alternate POPs and working with upstream transit provider. We will post updates every 15 minutes."

zach-support: posted initial customer note, escalated priority with support. customers on calls asked for ETA — tell them 1-2 hours for mitigation estimate.

olivia-oncall: action items assigned: raj -> provider ticket & routing changes. matt -> verify gateway fallback config and health checks. sophie/zach -> customer comms. olivia -> coordinate incident bridge + updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0421-EU3-NETWORK. Bridge: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000.

matt-eng: starting a controlled gateway failover test to eu3-secondary-pop now. will monitor error rates and token flows.

raj-netops: provider NOC confirmed a microburst in their aggregation fabric causing packet loss; they expect partial stabilization in ~30-45 mins and will implement a mitigation route.

matt-eng: after toggling fallback, errors dropped to baseline within ~3 minutes for a subset of customers routed to the secondary POP. still seeing elevated retransmits for sessions that remained on original path.

sophie-support: updating customers: "We have implemented a temporary routing fallback for eu3 which has reduced errors for many affected customers. Provider mitigation is in progress; we'll update when fully resolved." :white_check_mark:

zach-support: collecting post-mortem info from customers that still see problems. will attach logs to INC ticket.

olivia-oncall: reassigning to P2 monitoring after provider confirms mitigation and no further flapping for 30m. keeping bridge open for 1h for follow-up.

sophie-support: thanks everyone. I’ll follow up with customers and close once provider confirms fix and we see stable metrics for 1h.
